subject: ICT
title: So Many Colours!
subtitle: Hear the name and find the colour
hero_picture: A girl standing on a grassy island in the blue sky with her arms raised, a big bright rainbow above her and white clouds around.

sections.heading: The rainbow
text: Rain has stopped and a rainbow is in the sky.
Red, orange, yellow, green, blue and more.
sections.caption: A rainbow in the sky
sections.picture: A big bright rainbow with seven colours over green hills after the rain.

sections.heading: Colour pots
text: Each pot has a different colour.
Can you tell the colour in each pot?
sections.caption: Pots of paint
sections.picture: Six small open paint pots in a row: red, orange, yellow, green, blue and purple paint.

sections.heading: Listen to the computer
text: The computer says the name of a colour.
Listen carefully, then look at the pot.
sections.caption: Listening to the colour name
sections.picture: A girl wearing headphones at a laptop showing a single green paint pot, listening carefully.

sections.heading: Choose the right colour
text: Click on the word 'Orange' in the list.
Click the arrow to go to the next pot.
sections.caption: Picking the right colour
sections.picture: A laptop screen showing a pot of orange paint on the left and a column of plain coloured buttons on the right.

sections.heading: Colours around us
text: An apple is red. A banana is yellow.
Leaves are green. The sky is blue.
sections.caption: Colours all around
sections.picture: Children pointing at fruits and flowers of different colours on a table: red apple, yellow banana, green leaf, blue flower.

rhyme: Green like grass and sky so blue,
activity: Find one thing at home for each colour: red, yellow, green and blue.
talk: What did the girl see in the sky?
summary: There are many colours around us; we can hear a colour's name and find it.

questions.prompt: What appears in the sky after rain?
questions.explanation: A rainbow often appears after rain.

questions.prompt: What colour is the sky on a sunny day?
In the game, what do we do first?
questions.explanation: We listen to the name of the colour.
